title: Atelier: make only what's already sold
notes: Numbers in {braces} are filled from the recorded live run (scripts/capture.mjs writes them to src/data.json) so the narration matches the footage. Every other number is sourced in the README. The agent's line is the app's real hand-off message, voiced: labelled on screen as a dramatisation.

lines.text: Fashion has a business model. It fits in one word. Guess.
Design it. Make hundreds of them. Hope somebody wants one.
In twenty twenty-three, the industry guessed wrong on an estimated two and a half to five billion items.
And since July twenty twenty-six, large brands in the EU may no longer simply destroy what they didn't sell.
Small labels are spared the ban. Not the bill. They still pay for every unsold piece, after hours of specs and emails with factories, before a single customer has said yes.
So we built Atelier. Make only what's already sold.
Pick a mood board. Gemma 4, Google's open model, running on AMD GPUs, reads the trend. Silhouettes, palette, fabrics, and how sellable it is.
Most designers already have a drawing. Atelier reads it like a pattern cutter. Mandarin collar. Half placket. Side slits.
Press approve, and the agents take the paperwork. A costed tech pack, grounded in the brand book. Quote requests to each mill, in the mill's own language.
On our first live run, that took one minute fifty-four.
Then a quote comes back. 320 euros a piece, for a tunic that sells at 310 euros.

lines.text: This quote breaks your margin floor and your cost cap. Your call.
The agent stops and asks. You choose negotiate. It drafts the counter-offer at the exact price your margin allows, and Evolus sends it.
The revised quote passes. The pre-order goes live on Shopify. Real product, real checkout. And the factory order? It waits.
Five pre-orders clear the demo threshold. Only then does the purchase order go to the mill.
Three things make it different. Taste stays human: four creative calls, and every money decision is yours.
Rules, not vibes, decide the money. Margins are plain arithmetic, so the AI can't be sweet-talked.
And nothing is made up. Every model call is measured, live, on AMD.
Atelier. Make only what's already sold. Built on AMD, Gemma 4 and Evolus.
